actions.name: Thruster Boost
actions.description: The mech can use its land speed as a flight speed in zero-g for 1 round. Mechs with a flight speed can use this in gravity to increase their flight speed by 20'.

description.value:
The mech is immune to the off-kilter condition and can use half of its highest speed as its flight speed in zero-g. Mechs with a flight speed and this component improve their maneuverability to perfect and add 20' to its flight speed in zero-g.

@PPAbility[cost:1]{Thruster Boost} The mech can use its land speed as a flight speed in zero-g for 1 round. Mechs with a flight speed can use this in gravity to increase their flight speed by 20'.

Auxiliary Slots: 1.
